name: Werner
label: Werner
title: Werner's Nomenclature of Colours
description: 110 colours from the 1814 naturalists' guide by Abraham Gottlob Werner and Patrick Syme, the book Darwin took on the Beagle. Every colour is tied to an animal, a plant and a mineral: Skimmed-milk White, Arterial Blood Red, Verdigris Green. Muted, earthy and oddly domestic. A family of single colours, to be combined in the studio.
source: Werner's Nomenclature of Colours, second edition, 1821
data: Digitised by Nicholas Rougeux (c82.net/werner), via color-name-lists 3.34.0; CC0 public domain dedication
note: Values are a modern digital reading of hand-painted swatches in a 200-year-old book.
